Heard this was one of the top ten cookies in the country and I'd have to agree. I did only try the vegan chocolate chip walnut cookie and it was delicious. They were massive cookies, thick junts for sure but so good. Service was nice and I really liked the outside seating to try these cookies. I will say that eating the fresh is the best way to consume these delicious cookies.
Khalidah, thank you for the kind words about our vegan chocolate chip walnut cookies! We're so glad you enjoyed the fresh, handmade quality. Please visit us again soon. Sincerely, The Levain Team

Walked in just now at 11am on a Saturday to a staff member petting a customers dog.  Not cool!  She should not be stepping from behind the counter to pet anyones dog!   Dog hair is visibly moving around and landing near the customer!  Then they offer her a free sandwich like she is encouraged to come around with her untrained non-service dog!   Not cool!  This is a bakery!  Not a dog park! There's no seating, this should never happen!

Septima, we sincerely apologize for the disappointing experience. This doesn't reflect our standards, and we'd appreciate the opportunity to learn more details at info@levainbakery.com so we can turn this experience around. Sincerely, The Levain Team

I'll say it again too! Adding to all the others. That chocolate chip walnut cookie is the bizness!  Especially when they sell you one fresh off the #ovenrack!!! The structure of it allows the cooking process to leave that center, doughy goodness. I love how it camouflages the walnut surprises.  Totally worth the calories!

These cookies were so moist and filling. The service was great & it's a cute lil to-go spot to order your cookies from so be swift! Although the walnut chocolate chip is the most famous, I loved the double chocolate cookie as well as the peanut butter chocolate. I found the chocolate batter cookies to be super moist and just very flavorful melt in your mouth good. It had that mouth feel that I crave & love. Hot tip: order your cookie with a flat white and you'll get an adult version of cookies and milk

Kathy, thank you for visiting our Harlem bakery and sharing your kind words! We're delighted you enjoyed our signature cookies, especially the double chocolate and peanut butter chocolate varieties. Warmly, The Levain Team

I have been coming to Levain for years.  It's just the right amount of sweetness in a cookie.  I tired the coconut caramel chocolate chip cookie and I was blown away. I wish I would have purchased more. The service was nice and sweet like a cookie shop should be. The location was clean.  I will be back.

Tae, thank you for being a loyal Levain customer over the years! We're delighted you enjoyed our new coconut caramel chocolate chip cookie and that our team provided excellent service at our Harlem bakery. Your kind words brighten our day. Warmly, The Levain Team

i've always been curious about this place as i've heard great things about it. so when i was in town i made sure i made a stop here. so before heading to the airport i stopped by and ordered their top sellers. my favorite was the chocolate chip with nuts. two days later, the cookies were still as good as the day i bought them.

Maribeth, we're thrilled you enjoyed your first visit to our Harlem bakery! It's wonderful to hear our signature chocolate chip walnut cookies traveled well and delighted you days later. We take great pride in using quality ingredients to craft fresh, delectable treats daily. Thank you for your kind feedback - we truly appreciate it! Warmly, The Levain Team

We've heard of Levain Bakery being one of the bakeries to check in New York. We got the coconut chocolate chip cookie and it was so chewy and delicious, especially after our long walk through Central Park. We wished the cookie could be warmed up prior to handing it over - we didn't get the chance to go back to ask since the line got longer and we wanted to go to the Bethel Gospel Assembly service on time. I got to eat the cookie with a cup of coffee which enhanced the taste for me! Entering the shop you can tell it's a lovely bakery. It smelled so good as soon as you entered the space.

Michelle, thank you for your feedback and for visiting our Harlem bakery. We're delighted you enjoyed the coconut chocolate chip cookie, and we appreciate the suggestion. Our team takes great pride in handcrafting each batch from scratch daily using simple, quality ingredients. Sincerely, The Levain Team

This cute little bakery shop comes with an array of sweets treats. They are generous with their portions, and the service was swift, polite, and efficient.  Sweet treats right in the heart of Harlem. We had an assortment of the Lemon Cake, Oatmeal Cookie, Raisin Bread, Sour Cream Coffee Cake, and Banana Chocolate Chip cookie with a vanilla chai latte with oatmilk My favorite was the lemon cake. I thought the sour creme coffee cake would be the best, but it needed more cinnamon for me. I could see myself dropping in here again and again. There is no seating, just a grab and go spot. Although there are lawn chairs out front, those look like they are there for decoration...lol
It was great but get it warmed up or it just taste very much like a cake (more flour makes it cake like and less cookie)... recommended to add icecream!

Ynez, thank you so much for the fantastic review and helpful tip! We love that you enjoyed your experience at our Frederick Douglass Blvd bakery location, and your suggestion about pairing with ice cream sounds absolutely delicious. We appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts with us! Sincerely, The Levain Team
Service was not great when I visited on 1/15 at 11am. I asked for suggestions and the employee looked at me as if I was crazy. I spent $100 there and expected to be treated much better

Candy, we sincerely apologize for the disappointing experience you had at our Frederick Douglass Blvd bakery. We'd love to learn more details about what happened and work to turn this experience around - please reach out to us at info@levainbakery.com. Sincerely, The Levain Team
Love the cookies but found it a little unsanitary because the young lady never changed her gloves. She handled  the money and cookies  with the same gloves.

Keisha, thanks for your feedback and for visiting our bakery. We're sorry to hear your experience fell short. Please feel free to email us at info@levainbakery.com if you'd like to share any other details. Sincerely, The Levain Team
Hard to give 5 stars to a take-out only place, but my cookie was so delightful and memorable several months later. Decently friendly service. Fast and fresh -- and no wait!
Thank you for the kind words. We're thrilled to hear that our cookie left a lasting impression on you. We can't wait to welcome you back for another delightful treat soon! Warmly, The Levain Team

I like this Levain location because it's not too busy, it's on my way to Lidl and the 125th shops, and they generally have all the seasonal flavors/cookies stocked. Their staff is friendly and it's clean. This time around I tried the seasonal dark chocolate peppermint cookie and it was excellent! So, excellent that I forgot to take a picture before I ate it haha. I also grabbed a holiday tin for my family! They put out the cutest designs each year.

Hi Taylee, thanks for stopping by our Harlem bakery and sharing your experience! We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed the seasonal dark chocolate peppermint cookie. We hope to see you again soon. Warmly, The Levain Team

Yummy, thick, gooey burst of heaven in every bite! I stopped in here in my way to a colleague's get together. I had no wine but I saw this spot and was like wow!, it's right here. So I ordered a dozen assorted cookies nuts/no nuts, my gf has a severe allergy. Service was quick even with it filling up. Hopefully I will be back in the neighborhood

LeVain Bakery at this location is a straight walk for me up Central Park West. Central Park West turns into Frederick Douglass Boulevard and LeVain is easy to find in this busy neighborhood. I'm usually going to see a lot of places when I walk this far. I typically get a cookie to go and eat it when I stop somewhere to rest. I've never been to a LeVains where service wasn't friendly and timely. Employees know their business and get you on your way promptly. I'm definitely going to return and I'm recommending this location to you too. Just look at the reviews and photos. My mouth is watering thinking about the cookies and the Blueberry Muffin. I didn't care for the pound cake because the filling was too sweet. Other than that I've never been disappointed. It's still my favorite cookie of all time!!

This is the best place to get fresh cookies, coffee or tea.  Always friendly , always fresh I can't say enough good things about them. Sometimes there's a line out the door, trust me we'll worth the wait.

John, we're absolutely thrilled to hear about your wonderful experience at our Frederick Douglass Boulevard bakery! Your kind words about our team and treats truly make our day. We love hearing that you think the wait is worthwhile - that means everything to us. Sincerely, The Levain Team

Levain bakery met my expectations! I had a coffee and a lemon cookies! The lemon cookie was sorta dry on the outer edges but moist as you made your way to the middle. The customer service was really good and overall a good sweets and coffee spot!

Thank you for visiting! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our seasonal cookie and coffee. Your feedback is valuable to us, and we're glad you had a good experience overall. We look forward to welcoming you back for more sweet treats soon. Warmly, The Levain Team

I think about this cookie ...a LOT. When I first tried it that day, I thought you know it's a solid cookie. Have I had better though? The trip I took to New York that time had so many sad moments to it, but honestly this cookie was such a pick me up through a rough moment. Looking back, it was delicious, it was filling, it was THICC, and I would even say worth the price. The cookies are rich with butter and you can definitely taste the freshness of them. I think you can even ask to have them warmed up. The line at Levain moves fairly quickly, it's a grab and go service with small standing tables on the sides of the bakery. You can definitely stand and eat your cookie if you choose to! Space clears up quite quickly. The employees are very helpful when recommending options depending on the flavors you like. Definitely go, and bring your loved one back one too!

Ordered a few times from this location and have yet to have any issues. Order is always correct and is always packaged nicely. Cookies are phenomenal. My favorites are vegan and GF chocolate chip (which says a lot since I'm not the biggest fan of classic chocolate chip cookie) and oatmeal raisin cookie. They also had a lemon cookie that I loved but seem to take that off the menu. Brioche with cinnamon butter and oatmeal raisin scone are a couple of other items that I enjoy. Though a little pricey, the portions for most items are pretty big so would definitely order from here again!

Thank you so much for your kind words and for being a repeat customer! We're thrilled to hear that you've enjoyed our cookies and other treats. We appreciate your feedback on the seasonal lemon cookie and will definitely share it with our team. As for the pricing, we hand-make everything fresh daily using simple and quality ingredients, which is reflected in our prices. Thanks again for your support and for taking the time to share your experience. We look forward to serving you again soon. Warmly, The Levain Team

I just had a really unsatisfactory experience with this location. My husband and I had visited this location a few months ago and we saw they carried big beautiful bread. We saw what we considered to be a challah. I'm aware that the primary goods here are cookies. I simply called to ask if they had any challah. I was abruptly told many times and was laughed at that they never had challah and whatever I saw basically I was wrong. Whether I was wrong or right, my feelings were hurt. I didn't like how I was treated over the phone at all. I'm really disheartened at this interaction.

Erica, we sincerely regret the disappointing phone experience you described. We appreciate you taking the time to provide this feedback. Please feel free to email us at info@levainbakery.com if you'd like to discuss this further. We hope you'll give our Harlem bakery another opportunity to provide you with a much more enjoyable experience. Warmly, The Levain Team

This by far has been the BEST cookie I've ever had in my life!? It's been years since I've moved away from NYC and I still have yet to meet a cookie as delicious as these ones! The chocolate walnut chip cookies are my absolute favorite!?! It has the crispy shell on the outside, but once you bite into it, you have the gooey cookie dough in the inside. It's soft and fluffy and a whole lot of cookie! I would always think that I couldn't finish the cookie in one go...but, I literally can't stop eating it...and then suddenly the cookie vanishes! The other treats are just as wonderful. The oatmeal raisin cookie is also very delicious as well. The best part is having freshly baked cookies right out of the oven. It just melts in your mouth and the rush of pure happiness in each bite. I still dream about these cookies and I know this will be the first stop I make when I return to NYC again!?!!

Talk about a tasty cookie! My football team won tonight, and we bet a chocolate chip cookie as the prize. Levain was right next to the Harlem Tavern, so the famous shop was a no brainer. Small, clean and well lit with a full bakery cabinet and plenty of options even though it was 645pm. My friend chose the caramel coconut chocolate chip cookie for us (when I was leaning towards a basic CC) and I'm glad he did. It was magnificent! Perfectly undercooked, many layered deliciousness! I bought a mini wheat raisin roll to just to try it, and it was great too. Crispy on the outside and gooey on the inside. Would be even better toasted with some salty butter. While sitting there at the wrap around bar on some stools, the sweet server said she had accidentally bent an oatmeal raisin cookie and couldn't sell it. Would we like it. Ummm, YES please! Again, so good! Took half of it home. We have a bet going on the SF/Detroit game and there's a Dark chocolate peanut butter cookie riding on it. Can't wait to collect my booty!! Go SF!

When in rome ... so yes, I had to try the famous Levain chocolate cookie! Agree with other reviewers .... covid safety protocol and service are solid. The location is clean, bright and well organized. Now onto the cookie. .. my friend got the double chocolate peanut butter cookie and that to me is the hands down winner! It was perfect in every way - just the right amount of peanut butter chips to chocolate cookie ratio ... it was creamy and a nice contrast in flavor to solely chocolate chips and chocolate dough cookie. It was also perfectly baked throughout where the edges had it's nice crunchiness to it and the middle was baked through. I had the chocolate chip cookie which had a huge amount of chocolate chips ... too much for me as there was barely enough cookie per bite. The edges were also nice and crispy/crunchy but the middle seemed a little under baked for me. Still giving this 5 stars as I think it's personal preference on doneness as the double chocolate peanut butter cookie was spot on. Came back to by 6 for the family back at home.
My cousin said the best oatmeal cookies he'd had. Next to subway station. Must try cookies on East Coast.

Thanks so much for sharing your cousin's high praise for our oatmeal cookies! We're thrilled to hear they made such an impression. Being conveniently located next to the subway station makes it easy to grab a treat on the go. We hope to see you both again soon for more East Coast cookie adventures! Warmly, The Levain Team

Cookie monster here! Omg best cookies in the entire world! And look how ginormous it is, a must try in NYC! Location: It is located in Upper West side, interior is small and only take out! Service: not really interact with them, just buy and go! But you might ask them if it is your first time! Food: Everything was so delicious and ginormous! You will love all the flavors! CHOCO CHIP WALNUT: this the original flavor, this is so good! Best choco chip cookie I had! Big chunks of chocolate inside! DARK CHOCOLATE CHIP: omg so dark and gooey! Perfect for tea! DARK CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER: this is my favorite!! A must if you go! The chunks of peanut butter pieces is just heavenly good! I don't usually like peanut butter but this is an exemption! CHOCO CHIP BRIOCHE: meh, sorry this is the list I like here, the brioche itself is hard and taste old, maybe only that day. So just by cookies! Price rating: 7/10, the price matches all the deliciousness! Not bad for all the goodness. Been here multiple times so I am sure I am going back for the gooey deliciousness cookies! Get the DARK CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER!!
Most decadent cookies! Cooked perfectly! A little crispy on the outside and soft on the inside!
Mary, we're thrilled to hear you enjoyed our cookies. Thanks for sharing your love for our decadent treats. We can't wait to bake up more deliciousness for you soon! Warmly, The Levain Team

All the cookies we tried were incredible. The chocolate is gooey and the cookies are huge! My favorite is either the double chocolate or the oatmeal raisin! I don't like raisins- I'll eat them if I have too but I usually pick them out. But their oatmeal raisin cookie is incredible! The texture, the taste- impeccable... except for the raisins. If there was a plain oatmeal cookie, it would easily be my favorite. We also tried the two chip chocolate chip and the fall chocolate chunk. They were both good as well. I like the combination of different types of chocolate. It adds another dimension of flavor to the cookie. Personally, as much as I love chocolate, there was too much chocolate for me... you couldn't really taste the actual cookie component that much. Fall chunk is good if you like gingerbread- you can taste the other spices as well but ginger is the most prominent. I placed a pickup order to avoid any possible line. Service was good and the order was ready on time. This bakery location is small with limited space inside to eat. Overall, I will definitely be returning!

tldr: bomb-ass cookies that are baked FRESH throughout the day. Cookies with chocolate chips in them are a win in my book. YUM! Just delicious!  any cookie with chocolate chips in it for me is a win. The Double Chip Chocolate Chip cookie is A LOT of chocolate!! However it's ooey and gooey!! YUM. So just know you'll need space in you tummy to get this down cuz the cookies are pretty thiqq - in a GREAT WAY!!! So good. I especially LOVE that they bake all day so you always have it fresh.  pike I said: they're amazing! I highly recommend AND I love this bakery! Such a good product!! With friendly, professional service!
Is this a rhetorical questionDah‼The Two Chip Chocolate  Chip cookie  is heavenly divine. The staff, especially in Harlem, NY are AMAZING & stellar‼

Time and time again Levain hits the spot! Haven't found another cookie like them, and I'm not sure I want to! Love this location because it's always quick and never crowded. Staff is always a pleasure, too. The only problem I can think of is that I can never walk out with just one cookie... Hope everyone else has the same problem!

Food: Chocolate Chip Walnut 10/10 Double Chocolate Chip 7/10 Dark Chocolate 6/10 Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter 9/10 Tea 4/10 wouldn't order again These cookies are verryyyy decadent. Honestly one cookie is enough for me in one sitting. Walnut is my absolute fav. Peanut butter was also a great second runner up. The double chocolate was a little too much. I had to take breaks to finish this cookie because it is so rich and decadent. Dark chocolate is meh. Service: 10/10 very quick, efficient and polite
The cookies are to die for. I had the chocolate chip ball cookie when some coffee and was totally blissed out for like an hour

We're thrilled to hear that our chocolate chip walnut cookie paired with coffee brought you so much joy. Thanks for sharing your experience and for the awesome rating. Hope to see you again soon for another round of cookie bliss! Warmly, The Levain Team
These cookies never fail. Opted for the chocolate walnut cookie this time! Chewy, warm, decadent...simply amazing!
You can always count on us, Mario! See you soon. Best, The Levain Team :)

Got there chocolate chip walnut cookie with whole milk and it was pretty good! Compared to a normal cookie the cookies here are very thick. The edges are still crispy but the middle part is very soft and doughy. The walnut adds a perfect crunchiness and counters the sweetness of the chocolate. The cookie here is pretty good but i don't think it was mind blowing or life changing as it is very hyped up.

First, I am a cookie enthusiast. Second, I am alway in search of the best, chewiest and rich ingredient filled cookies. I stopped here with a friend who swears by these baked goods. This cookie DOES NOT DISAPPOINT! At the whopping price of $5.00 it is well worth the value. The cookie is "plump", so it's not some thin treat. I had the chocolate chip walnut and I tried a nibble of the oatmeal raisin. I may just return tomorrow to get some cookie to go home with.

Dropped by on my way back to Philly. As with most places in the city, parking was a pain ... however I was determined to try one of these infamous pounder cookies. I am so happy that I was able to secure parking on a side street! I oh so very quickly dashed over to pick up some sweets for the ride home. I ordered a blueberry muffin, a walnut chocolate chip cookie, and a cinnamon brioche. The blueberry muffin was a great road snack (I ate half and saved the other half for breakfast the next day). Super moist and packed with blueberries! The brioche...meh! Either it was old and dried out or I received a bad batch. I love cinnamon or coconut on just about anything but I was highly disappointed with this treat. Good thing it was not what I came for. I would not order it again. Now about that walnut chocolate chip cookie... OMG! What a gooey, chewy, chocolate chip goodie!! To be honest, I can not and did not, finish this treat in one sitting. I cut 1/4 piece, wrapped it in foil, and lightly warmed it in the oven. Best way to have it! It was so soft and went perfect with my evening tea. The $4 price tag is not that bad either. Especially considering the size. I enjoyed that cookie for several days.

The best cookie I have ever had in my life. I'm always here whether it be for a snack, post-exam treat, or picking cookies up as gifts for friends or to travel with. I recently brought a dozen with me to Atlanta for a Thanksgiving dinner and they were an absolute hit! All 4 flavors are amazing but my favorites are the chocolate peanut butter and the oatmeal raisin. These are normally cookies I would not prefer but Levain Bakery has completely changed my opinion of them. Can't get enough of these massively delicious cookies that have the best flavors and textures a cookie could possibly have!
I had the chocolate walnut cookie which is the most popular item. It was nice and crunchy on the outside and gooey on the inside. A little treasure-a must stop!

Super quick service from this location! I had never been before so had to check out the hype with Levain bakery! I went on a Saturday morning around 10:30 AM and there was no line so I didn't have to deal with the crazy lines every one's always talking about. I got the two chip chocolate cookie and my mom got the famous walnut one. I found that the two chip one was extremelyyy sweet (even for someone who absolutely loves chocolate and sweets). I didn't try the walnut one because I'm allergic to it but both my mom and brother said they couldn't even taste the walnuts and agreed it was too sweet. As the price point, I thought $5 was completely reasonable since the cookie was HUGE. Overall, if you like Levain Bakery, it's probably best to go in the mornings since it seems to be there are less lines but not sure if I would personally be going back!
I really enjoy the cookies and the cake my only issue is the cake slices are VERY SMALL. And there's no incentive when you buy any cookies like any coupon.
Hi Beverley, thanks for sharing your thoughts with us. We're thrilled to hear you enjoy our cookies and cake. We appreciate your feedback and hope to have you back soon! Warmly, The Levain Team
Just get extra for later, you're going to want more. The cookies are perfection. Indulge yourself because it's worth it.
Thanks for the sweet words. We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed our cookies. Hope to see you again soon for another round of cookie perfection! Warmly, The Levain Team

I first discovered Levain Bakery because they won NYC's Munch Madness 2016 for their walnut chocolate chip cookie. I am so glad I did! Their cookies if we can call them that are in a league of their own. Instead of being flat, they are tall, round, and incredible moist. Beware, each cookie packs in about 600-700 calories. I once made the mistake if giving a whole cookie to each of my children. I knew the cookies were over the top when my children couldn't even finish the cookie and said they were full. That has never happened before. Since 2016, my favorite cookie has become their oatmeal raisin -- cranberry raisin? -- cookie. Its crumbly and moist texture makes it a cross between a scone and a cookie and is the best oatmeal cookie I've ever had. My kids have gravitated more towards the double chocolate cookie as well. Of late, the walnut chocolate chip cookies have been sightly undercooked, with a gooey center of undercooked cookie dough. I told the bakery and they said I should just wait to eat it because it is like that when it is fresh out of the oven. So, basically, they didn't believe me! I ate it 1 hour, 6 hours and 12 hours after purchasing and it was still undercooked in the center. I will still eat this heavenly dessert, but it makes me think twice before buying it as a gift for someone.

You can avoid the lines by trying this location of the bakery chain. I got a dark chocolate peanut butter chip cookie: to me, I still think they bake their cookies too little. Most of the cookie I got was uncooked inside, and made me nauseous. It tasted good, but it's not what I look for in a cookie, which must be baked all through. No reason to go back.

While celebrating my Bestie's birthday an impromptu trip to Levain took place as we waited for another party member. Small shop with great service and a bunch of goodies to choose from.  With a cookie explosion seemingly taking place in the city Levain is a long time contender and a good competitor. However they are not a one trick pony. They do Cookies, Cakes, Muffins, Coffee and etc. I honestly couldn't remember if and when I had Levain's previously and with an unofficial Cookie Challenge presented to me by fellow yelper Alana D. I was intrigued to try a cookie as I purchased my bestie a very large slice of lemon pound cake. The chocolate chip walnut cookie was oversized full of chips and a good amount of walnuts that didn't overpower the cookie. Sweet and gooey and nice weather warm or not. Overall a good treat... let's face it, its hard to go wrong with sugar, chocolate and carbs. Lol Just A Note: As the cookies are big, the suggested cookie care instructions are recommended.

It is a sin to have cookies this good. Like I don't even eat cookies like that, sugar is evil as far as I am concern, but evil is this heavenly, then I have been sadly mistaken for most of my life. Take me back to New York, I need another monster chocolate cookie so I can live again. That just about sums it up!

I discovered Levain Bakery many years ago while living in NYC. It has been 16 years since I moved away, and they are STILL one of the few places I go out of my way to visit whenever I return to NYC. My favorites are their brioche, especially the chocolate chip version, and any of the cookies. Give them a try! You won't be sorry. P.S. Don't be deterred by a line. The wait is worth it!
Got the vegan cookie. Kinda expensive for a cookie, but it was a decent size. I'm glad I tried it, but I probably wouldn't go again. Definitely worth at least a visit.

Thank you for giving our Vegan & GF Chocolate Chip Walnut cookie a try. We hope you'll reconsider and give us another chance to impress you with our delicious treats. Your support means a lot to us! -The Levain Team

Five dollars for a chocolate chip cookie is highway robbery. But I'll easily be robbed because those cookies were delicious. Next time I'll just come with cash because I think they do a surcharge if you pay with a card. The place is pretty busy and there was a line out the door, which kind of shows that It's a good place to eat at.

Not to be dramatic but I'd do anything for these cookies. They are a buttery and chocolatey amazing gift to earth with a nice crisp outside but super gooey and moist inside. I have a huge sweet tooth so I'm bias, but I seriously love these cookies and go every time I'm in New York. If you aren't a huge fan of sweets, I'd recommend getting some milk for the side to wash everything down with. YUM.
Banana chocolate.chip slice was tasty, moist and flavorful! Iced coffee was great! Will return!
The cookies are good.  The service was quick and they were pleasant.  I ordered on line snd picked it up.  I would go back again.

Thank you for your kind words, Chrissy. We're delighted to hear you enjoyed our cookies and had a pleasant experience with our team. We can't wait to welcome you back for more delicious treats!  -The Levain Team

Not that Levain needs my review, but I will quickly say they deserve all five of these stars. Warm and slightly gooey on the inside every time. I always get the chocolate chip with walnut, but you can't go wrong with any of them. Always a stop I make if I'm nearby one of their locations.

It's a GIFT and a CURSE that I discovered that Levain Bakery was literally just around the corner from my Air BnB in Harlem on the LAST DAY that I was staying there. I bought one of each cookie (which was a small fortune) and brought them to my friends house as a hostess gift. We ended up opening a bottle of champagne and tasting each cookie. Chocolate chip walnut was my favorite. No wait, oatmeal raisin. The chocolate chip peanut butter was too rich. No, I take it back, just eat a small bite of it to feel completely satisfied. UNBELIEVABLE.

The staff is really nice and friendly. She indulged in my excitement to finally try Levain's. The cookies are better when warm. However, my only gripe with this place is that everything is $5 each. In my opinion, I don't think it's worth $5 for a cookie, but to each their own. It's still a must-try for foodies alike.

Levain is the best! They have a new cookie now with coconut. I like the classic but no coconut for me. The peanut butter chocolate is the best. The two chip chocolate chip is 2nd best but not by much. Love this spot and every location is consistent! 5 stars.

Calling them a cookie is an understatement. It's a hefty pastry with a gooey moist interior. Think of a cross between a cake and cookie. It's 4 dollars for a cookie which astonishes me but it's literally a meal. You only need one!! My cookie was straight out the oven. So here is the trick. Give it an hour or so to firm up. The anticipation will kill you but it's worth it. The exterior gets nice and crunchy while the inside is still pleasantly soft.
This place is dangerous for your diet. The Walnut Chocolate Chip cookies are a must have.
We're so glad you enjoyed! -The Levain Team :)
Very good caramel coconut chocolate chip cookie! Texture was perfect, gooey inside, soft with light crunch texture outside. I would recommend! Service was very nice. Thank you!

My first bite of their famous chocolate cookie was a bit unimpressive. I got here 20 minutes after the opened, and there was no line. I got my cookie right away, but it was cold. Surprisingly, however, the chocolate chips inside were still gooey. What kind of sorcery is this?! Its a good cookie, but I don't think I would go out of my way for it.

A friend treated me to some desert here, we got some chocolate chip cookies and I had to try the Lemon cake (my favorite), unfortunately the lemon cake was too bitter for my taste but I fell in love with the chocolate chip cookies, so warm & Delish! Small little bake shop with very friendly workers. I'll be back for more cookies!

You know you are one special person if l bring you a Levain cookie or a slice of their amazing lemon, banana nut and walnut slices of cakes.....OMG!! The #1 reason l patronize this bakery frequently is also due to their excellent customer service. Like the one l had this Sunday 2/25/2024 at their Harlem location with the manager Destiny. Destiny was super courteous in making my very complicated order for 15 cookies and cakes were arranged correctly. She took her time in placing the cookies and cakes delicately in the boxes beautifully....appreciate it Destiny Also, she is also quite pretty!!!!
